No penalty applies if the explanation is bona fide and all material facts are disclosed under s.439(8).

citation.provision: Section 2(6), Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017

conditions.why: The supplier is located in India, as stated in the facts.

conditions.condition: the recipient of service is located outside India;
conditions.why: The recipient is located in India, as stated in the facts.

conditions.condition: the place of supply of service is outside India;

conditions.why: The payment was received in Indian rupees via NEFT bank transfer, which is permitted by the Reserve Bank of India.

conditions.condition: the supplier of service and the recipient of service are not merely establishments of a distinct person in accordance with Explanation 1 in section 8;

mutated_regimes.consequence_if_failed: If the supply is not an export of services, it will be subject to GST at the applicable rate. The supplier will need to pay the tax and any applicable interest under Section 50 of the CGST Act 2017. If there is a short payment or non-payment of tax, the supplier may also face penalties under Section 74A of the CGST Act 2017.
